metadata.notes: updateIsolatedMargin is an L1 action (phantom-agent scheme), signed exactly like `order` — the wrapper must dispatch it to the agent tier, not the master tier. msgpack is the exact preimage keccak-hashed (with nonce/vaultAddress/expiresAfter appended as raw bytes, per action_hash()) to build the phantom-agent EIP-712 message that source/connectionId wraps. Per-position margin adjustment without external fund movement, so shares the agent tier with leverage changes.
